## Research & Professional Experience

::: cv-item
[University of the Pacific, Stockton, CA]{.org} [M.S. student, Odom
Lab]{.role} [2025 — 2027]{.when}

**Passive acoustic monitoring of urban bird communities.** I am using
automated acoustic recorders (AudioMoths) and machine learning-based
species identification (BirdNET) to assess patterns in bird species
richness and occupancy in relation to vegetation structure and urban
land use to inform citywide greening initiatives.
:::

\

::: cv-item
[California State University, Los Angeles]{.org} [Research Assistant,
Wood Lab of Avian and Urban Ecology]{.role} [May — December 2024]{.when}

**Urban food web dynamics.** Conducted point-count bird surveys
evaluating how the planting of 200 oak trees on campus contributed to
urban biodiversity. Examined the capacity of native and non-native oaks
to support urban food webs, including insects and birds.
:::

\

::: cv-item
[U.S. Geological Survey, Southwest Biological Science Center, Moab, UT]{.org}
[Biological Science Technician]{.role} [February — December
2023]{.when}

**Terrestrial dryland ecology.** Conducted extensive fieldwork across a
suite of projects spanning adaptive management, dust and aeolian
processes, rangeland management, sediment transport, dryland inventory
and monitoring, biological soil crusts, wildfire, and nonnative species.
:::

\

::: cv-item
[Cornell Lab of Ornithology & Western Sydney University]{.org} [Lyrebird
Lab — NSF Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU)]{.role} [June —
August 2022]{.when}

**Superb Lyrebird behavioral ecology.** Studied vocal behavior and song
dialects across the species' population range in eastern Australia.
Deployed SWIFT autonomous audio recorders and motion-triggered cameras
near display mounds and managed the resulting data.
:::

\

::: cv-item
[Cornell University Plant Pathology Herbarium, Ithaca, NY]{.org} [Museum Curatorial
Assistant]{.role} [November 2018 — November 2019]{.when}

**Fungal biology.** Packaged and labelled fungal specimens for museum
research.
:::
